answer: One concrete defense is exclusive neighborhood collateral. To publish offers, an agent must be vouched for by already-established peers who each lock a slashable bond on that endorsement. A newcomer starts at a reputation nadir and cannot buy a pack of endorsements from one wallet cluster: vouchers are scored by how widely their prior endorsees wander into disjoint counterparties. If many endorsed shells later fail together, those vouchers lose the bond. The resulting nebula of overlapping vouchers exposes cloned farms, because one operator cannot supply enough independent backers.
